item.name: Performs a disruption move operation (IROP or diversion) for a group of bookings.

request.name: Performs a disruption move operation (IROP or diversion) for a group of bookings.

description.content:
Use the dotREZ NSK API's GET /api/nsk/v1/settings/booking/reserveFlights to retrieve
related role settings:
    
        
        daysBeforeIrop:  This value must be a positive number, and the departure
        date of the request must not be more than this number of days after today.
        
        
        allowMove:  This value must not be set to MoveFlightCode.NotAllowed.
        
        
        allowMoveOverbook:  If InventoryControlType in the request is set to
        OversellSpace, this value must be set to OverbookControl.CanOverbookLeg.
        
        
        allowCreateAdhocConnect:  If ToJourneyKey in the request corresponds to a
        journey containing any ad hoc connections, this value must be true.
        
    
Use the dotREZ NSK API's GET /api/nsk/v1/settings/general/operations to retrieve
related role settings:
    
        
        allowConsoleIrop:  This value must be true.
        
        
        allowDiversionIrop:  If MoveType in the request is set to
        DisruptionMoveType.Diversion, this value must be true.
        
        
        allowIropOversellOnToFlight:  If InventoryControlType in the request is set to
        OversellSpace, this value must be true.
        
    
To performs a stateful move operation (IROP or diversion), use the dotREZ NSK API's
POST /api/nsk/v1/trip/move/irop.

GraphQL endpoint: dcsPerformDisruptionMove
